buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of Oil Industry Development Board, Payable at New Delhi

A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 2. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 3. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 4. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 5. Past Project Experience Commercial Experience Criteria for Service Contracts: For experience, the single work executed by the bidder, as main or subcontractor, during any of the last five years ending on last day of the month immediately previous to the month in which the last date of bid submission (in case of extended bid submission date, original bid submission date shall be considered) falls should be considered as detailed below: (a) Three similar successfully completed works 40% each costing not less than the amount equal to Rs 240000 . OR (b) Two similar successfully completed works 50% each costing not less than the amount equal to Rs 300000 . OR (c) One similar successfully completed work 80% costing not less than the amount equal to Rs 480000 . Single/ Two/ Three Completed work order value as indicated above should be exclusive of GST. 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific SLA Text Clause(s) Eligibility Criteria: The eligibility criteria for the bidders are as follows: i). The bidder must possess a valid OEM authorized service provider certificate issued by M/ s Xerox India Ltd. A copy of the certificate along with supporting communication from M/s Xerox India Lt d. in this regard must be submitted with the bid.

ii). The bidder must have an office located in Noida or Delhi. As proof, the bidder shall submit a copy of the GST/MSME Registration Certificate and Company/Firm Registration Certificate issued by the co ncerned authority along with the bid. iii). The bidder must have at least one year experience ending 31st March, 2026 in providin g after-sales service/maintenance of Multifunction Photocopier Machine to Central/State Gove rnment Ministries/Departments/PSUs/ Autonomous Bodies located in Delhi/NCR. Copies of releva nt CSMA/FSMA/orders must be submitted with the bid. (a) Three similar successfully completed works of 40% each costing not less than the amount equal to Rs 2,40,000/-, OR (b) Two similar successfully completed works of 50% each costing not less than the amount equal to Rs.3,0 0,000/- OR (c) One similar successfully completed work of 80% costing not less than the amount equal to Rs.4,80,000/ -. iv). The average annual financial turnover during the last three financial years ending 31st March, 2025, should not be less than Rs. 1.80 lakh i.e. 30% of the estimated value of the contr act of three years, duly certified by a Chartered Accountant (CA) confirming the turnover. vi). The bidder shall submit an EMD of Rs. 15,000/- in favour of Oil Industry Development Bo ard, payable at New Delhi, in the form of a banker’s cheque issued by a commercial bank, along with th e bid (scan copy of the same should be submitted failing which the bid shall not be entertained). vi). The bidder must have a valid PAN and GST Registration in the name of the Proprietor/o wner/Firm/Company. Self-attested copies of the same must be submitted with the bid. vii). The bidder must not have been blacklisted or placed on holiday by GeM or any Governm ent/Semi-Government/Autonomous Body/PSUs etc. A self-declaration/undertaking to this effect must be submitted with the bid. Note: MSME and Startup vendors are exempted from submission of documents relating to prio r experience and turnover criteria, as well as from furnishing the EMD subject to submission of valid supporting certificates. Scope of Work: The scopes of works under contract are as follows: (i). Supply and installation of all consumables items such as ink cartridges, toner, drums, other all c onsumable items etc. from the date of award of contract up to completion of contract. (ii) Quarterly preventive maintenance (minimum four (04) visits per year) by qualified engineer/tech nician from the date of award of contract up to validity of contract. . (iii). Supply, repair and replacement of defective parts including software/firmware updates etc., wher ever applicable/required from the date of award of contract up to validity of contract. (iv). On-site service support for all working days, whenever required, during entire contract period. (v). All parts shall be of OEM make. Commercial Bid Conditions: The bidder shall quote the FSMA/CSMA charges in the prescribed Price Bid format. The bids shall be evaluated on the basis of the aggregat e cost of the estimated photocopying requirements for the entire three-year contract period, as specified in the Price Bid format. All bidders shall be responsible for ensuri ng the accuracy and completeness of the rates quoted in their respective Price Bids. I n the event that a bidder quotes an erroneous rate, the bidder shall remain bound by

the rates so quoted and, if awarded the contract as the L-1 bidder, shall be required to provide the services at the quoted rates, subject to the terms and conditions of the bid. The contract shall be awarded to the eligible bidder quoting the lowest evaluate d total cost (L1) for the estimated photocopying requirements over the entire three-y ear contract period. The quoted rates shall be inclusive of all applicable taxes, dutie s, levies and GST. No additional payment on account of such charges shall be admiss ible. In the event that OIDB extends the contract beyond the initial three-year contra ct period, the contractor shall continue to provide the services during the fourth year at the rates quoted and applicable for the third year of the contract. For the fifth year , the rates applicable during the third year shall be increased by 10%, if mutually agr eed by the both parties. Note: All prospective bidders participating in the GeM bid are hereby advised to carefully read and examin e the attached OIDB Bid (1794294226.pdf) document, including the Financial Bid under the Single Packet System, and ensure that they fully understand and comply with all the terms, conditions, specifications an d requirements stipulated therein before submission of their bids.
